fusions.name: Pond Scum
fusions.desc: Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back. Flicks a sodden spore at a target up to 6 tiles away for 7 water damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, with Rot for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and a 50% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mildew Dabble
fusions.desc: Sprays damp spores through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 water damage to everything in it, 10% more for each affliction already on the target, up to 50% more.

fusions.name: Calm Float
fusions.desc: Restores 10 health and 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolls Right Off
fusions.desc: Each debuff laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it instead. You regenerate 0.4 health a second.
